episodes.title: He defended the Jonestown cult leader. Then Jonestown took his son.
episodes.description:
Nearly half a century after the horrors of Jonestown, Tim Stoen is confronting the most painful chapter of his life in a new memoir, "My War with the Devil of Jonestown." A Stanford graduate and former San Francisco deputy district attorney, Stoen says he was drawn to Jim Jones and the People’s Temple by what he believed was a movement devoted to racial, economic and social equality. On "California Stories with Giselle Fernandez," he shares how he eventually became Jones’ pro bono attorney and spent seven years helping build what he says he believed could be a more just society.
